errors.description: The hem's edge topstitching is present but low-contrast at this exposure; the rolled-edge finish reads more by silhouette than by visible stitch line.
errors.expected: Rolled hem edge with its finishing stitch legible.
errors.actual: Hem edge cleanly finished and correctly level; stitch line faint against the white poplin.
errors.correction: Acceptable as shipped. If ever re-shot, add a touch more raking light along the hem to lift the stitch line.

lockedFeatures: straight level hem at an even height all the way around
photorealistic white cotton poplin, zero annotations
notes: Attempt 2 resolved both attempt-1 errors: the location/architecture set was replaced with a seamless neutral light-grey studio, and the crop now puts the level hem and BOTH side-seam vents as the dominant subject with only a shallow band of trouser below. Hem geometry reads unambiguously straight — a customer can distinguish it from the curved-hem sibling at a glance. Adversarial check found no generic substitution, no annotation leakage, no front/back confusion, no invented features.
